WITH counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt, COUNT(*) as num_projects
  FROM counts
)
SELECT 
  c.arcref,
  c.cnt,
  CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_cnt as share,
  (CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_cnt) - (1.0 / t.num_projects) as deviation
FROM counts c
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY deviation IS NULL, deviation DESC
LIMIT 10
